translations.clear-quran: By the sun and its brightness
translations.pickthall: By the sun and his brightness

translations.clear-quran: and the moon as it follows it
translations.pickthall: And the moon when she followeth him

translations.clear-quran: and the day as it unveils it
translations.pickthall: And the day when it revealeth him

translations.clear-quran: and the night as it conceals it
translations.pickthall: And the night when it enshroudeth him

translations.clear-quran: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it
translations.pickthall: And the heaven and Him Who built it

translations.clear-quran: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it
translations.pickthall: And the earth and Him Who spread it

translations.clear-quran: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it
translations.pickthall: And a soul and Him Who perfected it

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: sonra da ona bozukluğunu ve korunmasını ilham edene ki
translations.diyanet-isleri: Sonra da ona iyilik ve kötülük kabiliyeti verene and olsun ki
translations.clear-quran: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it
translations.pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: gerçek kurtuluş bulmuştur onu temizlikle parlatan
translations.clear-quran: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul
translations.pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Onu kirletip gömen de ziyan etmiştir
translations.diyanet-isleri: Kendini fenalıklara gömen kimse de ziyana uğramıştır
translations.clear-quran: and doomed is the one who corrupts it
translations.pickthall: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it

translations.diyanet-isleri: Semud milleti, içlerinden en azgını ileri atılınca, azgınlığı yüzünden peygamberleri yalanladı
translations.clear-quran: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance
translations.pickthall: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride

translations.diyanet-isleri: Semud milleti, içlerinden en azgını ileri atılınca, azgınlığı yüzünden peygamberleri yalanladı
translations.clear-quran: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺
translations.pickthall: When the basest of them broke forth

segments.content: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Allah´ın elçisi onlara: «Allah´ın devesini ve onun sulanışını gözetin!» demişti
translations.diyanet-isleri: Allah'ın peygamberi onlara, Allah'ın devesini göstermiş ve: "Allah'ın bu devesine ve onun su hakkına dokunmayın" demişti
translations.clear-quran: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”
translations.pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink

segments.content: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Fakat ona inanmadılar da onu (deveyi) devirdiler. Rableri de günahlarını başlarına geçiri geçiriverdi de o yeri düzleyiverdi
translations.diyanet-isleri: Onu yalanladılar ve deveyi boğazladılar. Bunun üzerine Rableri, suçlarından dolayı onların üzerine katmerli azap indirdi; yerle bir etti onları
translations.clear-quran: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground
translations.pickthall: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings)

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Öyle ya, O, o işin sonundan korkacak değil ki
translations.diyanet-isleri: Bu işin sonundan O'nun korkusu yoktur
translations.clear-quran: He has no fear of consequences
translations.pickthall: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events)
